name: lantern
label: Lantern - the storyteller
note: Warm, dark, illustrated. Arabic leads in a gold-lit naskh, English follows beneath in a classical serif. Built for stories, hadith narrations and reminders told as a scene.
reference: Measured from a 720x1280 reference reel: Arabic line at about 15% of frame height, English at about 20%, handle right-aligned at about 25%, source line at about 74%, brand lockup at about 81%. Roughly one line per 2 seconds. The reference puts the source line at about 74% and the brand at about 81%; both are moved up here so the Reels caption and audio strip (everything below y=1440 on a 1920 frame) never cover them.
